_about: FL Studio behaviours that fl-headless ran into which the manual doesn't warn about (or that differ from it). Our own notes. verified_on: FL versions where this was seen ('2026' = FL 2026 on an fl-headless developer's PC, exact build not recorded). instructions=false keeps a quirk out of the server's connect-time instructions (too low-level).

quirks.title: Opening an .flp from outside can start a second FL
quirks.summary: Launching an .flp from Explorer or the shell while FL runs can start a second copy of FL instead of opening it in the running one.
quirks.do: Open projects inside the running FL (FILE > Open / Ctrl+O; fl_open does this). Never start a second FL.

quirks.title: Re-opening the open project does nothing
quirks.summary: FL ignores a request to open the project it already has open, so edits made to its .flp on disk don't show.
quirks.do: Switch FL to a blank template, then open the project again. Don't quit FL to refresh.

quirks.title: FL saves its in-memory copy over disk edits
quirks.summary: FL keeps the open project in memory; any later save (yours, autosave, 'save changes? Yes') writes that copy over changes made to the .flp file on disk.
quirks.do: Save from FL first, edit the file, reload straight away, and answer 'No' to 'save changes?' on that reload.

quirks.title: Command-line render needs FL closed
quirks.summary: A command-line render (FL64.exe /R) is handed to the FL that's already open instead of rendering in the background.
quirks.do: Render from inside the open FL (fl_render method='in_fl'), or close FL once for a batch of renders - not per edit.

quirks.title: Demo plugins warn on save
quirks.summary: Saving a project that uses a plugin your edition doesn't include shows a trial/demo warning; such projects later reopen with the plugin silenced or noisy.
quirks.do: Remove or replace that plugin. Never answer 'Save anyway' on the user's behalf.

quirks.title: FL's message boxes have painted buttons
quirks.summary: FL's own dialogs (save changes?, warnings) draw their buttons and text themselves, so automation can't read or click them as normal Windows controls.
quirks.do: Answer them with the key that the button stands for (fl_dialog click does this); read them from a picture (fl_snapshot hwnd=...).

quirks.title: Projects can start playing right after loading
quirks.summary: FL may start playback by itself after a project loads.
quirks.do: Stop playback after opening (fl-headless's tools do).

quirks.title: FL won't switch projects while playing
quirks.summary: Opening another project while the transport is running doesn't go through.

quirks.title: Transport changes apply after the script returns
quirks.summary: Changes made from FL's MIDI scripting API (play, position, tempo) take effect after the script callback ends, so reading them back in the same callback gives the old value.
quirks.do: Read the state back in a later call.

quirks.title: First bridge call after a restart is often slow
quirks.summary: The first round trip to FL's MIDI script after FL or the client restarts often times out.

quirks.title: Plugin windows are separate top-level windows
quirks.summary: Detached plugin, channel and mixer windows are their own top-level windows; closing FL's main window message doesn't reach them and vice versa.
quirks.do: Target FL's main window for app-level messages; treat floating windows separately.

quirks.title: Untitled projects are called 'Project N' in FL 2026
quirks.summary: FL 2026 names new unsaved projects 'Project 1', 'Project 2'... (older versions: 'Untitled'); saving one opens Save As.
quirks.do: Don't auto-save untitled projects; ask the user for a name and folder.

quirks.title: .flp stores playlist track n as 500 - n
quirks.summary: In the .flp file a playlist clip's track index is stored reversed: playlist track n is written as 500 - n.
quirks.do: Convert both ways when reading or writing clips.

quirks.title: .flp clip mute flag is 0x2000
quirks.summary: A muted playlist clip has bit 0x2000 set in its item flags.
quirks.do: Test / set that bit for clip mute.

quirks.title: .flp audio clip settings live in channel event 215
quirks.summary: An audio clip channel's settings (fades, reverse, stretch, start/length...) are stored in channel event 215.
quirks.do: Edit that event for audio clip settings.
